en: A vintage, tinted interior view of a large Romanesque/Gothic cathedral. The image shows a long stone nave with high vaulted ceilings, rounded arches, tall narrow windows, and an ornate pulpit reached by a staircase guarded by sculpted lions. Wooden choir stalls, kneeling rails, and religious furnishings line the right side; a solitary figure kneels in prayer in the distance. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and the publisher.
